stem: For A(4) and B(10), point C divides segment AB internally in the ratio 2:1. Mark C on the number line.
solution: Internal division with m=2, n=1: $x=\frac{n a+m b}{m+n}$.

hints.text: Cross-multiply: weight each end by the other part of the ratio, then divide by the sum.
Only one point C is asked for, between A and B.
All the numbers here are positive; recheck your arithmetic.
